🎤✨ Show: The Next Headliner

Five aspiring stars get the opportunity of a lifetime when they enter a competition designed to find the next big name in music. Each performer brings a different style and personality to the stage, but the dream of becoming a headliner comes with plenty of pressure, competition, and unexpected challenges.

As the girls navigate performances and the ups and downs of chasing their dreams, their relationships begin to change. What started as a competition slowly becomes a genuine friendship, with each girl learning to trust, encourage, and rely on the others.

Eventually, they realize that their greatest opportunity may not be about winning individually. By combining their talents, they form a band and set out to build something together, hoping to make their own mark in the music industry.

The cast includes Olivia Taylor Cohen, Kate Mina Lin, Journey Montana, Indi Star, and Giselle Torres.
